title: Section 16 — Suits to be instituted where subject-matter situate — CPC 1908

content.heading: Suits to be instituted where subject-matter situate
content.text: Subject to the pecuniary or other limitations prescribed by any law, suits for the recovery of immovable property, partition, foreclosure, sale or redemption, determination of any other right to or interest in immovable property, compensation for wrong to immovable property, and the other classes enacted in Section 16 shall be instituted in the Court within the local limits of whose jurisdiction the property is situate, with the proviso for relief obtainable through the defendant's personal obedience. Read the official clauses.
